title: Red Desire Sunflower - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Dward Red Sunflower - Rare Variety
description:
Sunflower ‘Red Desire’ is valued for its bold, deep red blooms, making it an excellent choice for garden borders or patio containers. Its striking crimson petals stand out beautifully against green foliage and are perfect for adding color to fresh-cut floral arrangements.

         Mini plug sunflower plants are easy to grow and establish quickly. Pot on soon after arrival into well-drained compost and place in a sunny, sheltered spot. Keep the soil consistently moist but not waterlogged, and protect from frost while young. As plants grow, they can be gradually acclimatised to outdoor conditions.
